messages:
Maya: Quick sync — Optimize toolkit blocker roundup. Milestone: v0.2 quant+batching+cache by end of week. Owners I have in mind: @Aj (quant), @Simon (batching), @Eva (caching). Dependencies: eng-runtime kernel perf patch, eng-platform infra PR (once merged). Please post one-line status and blockers.

Aj: Quant update: PR open (612), bench runs show ~1.7x throughput on int8 and ~18% cost drop vs fp16. Waiting on nightly perf job and code review. No functional regressions seen locally.

Simon: Batching status: implemented adaptive batcher changes, but blocked by kv-cache eviction bug in runtime (causes OOM on long tails). Filed PR 498 to eng-runtime, pinged them earlier.

Eva: Cache integration: hit a TTL collision in staging — two namespaces sharing prefix + TTL reset. Tests failing in e2e. Temporary workaround: force unique namespace per deploy. Working on a deterministic fix + migration script, ETA EOD.

Ryan: Quick question — who owns the regression-alert playbook for this release? I can wire dashboard alerts into Console once I have the runbook.

Aj: I own regression alerts for Optimize toolkit for this sprint. I'll add the playbook to the repo and add RBAC for alert edit. @Ryan can take console wiring after I finish.

Maya: Good. New milestone set: v0.2 cut = 1766174400 (2026-03-20). Can we add a canary + fallback policy to reduce blast radius?

Simon: Canary policy proto: ```
canary_policy:
  percent: 5
  fallback: model-small
  monitor: [latency_p99, error_rate, cpu_overload]
```
Will add as config in the rollout PR.

deploy-bot: perf-run/1766001275 finished — all checks green except kv-evict-test failed on runtime-qa (see logs: https://ci.internal/runs/1766001275) :warning:

Aj: Thanks — that aligns with my bench job failing intermittently. I re-ran perf job with kernel patch disabled to reproduce consistently. I can attach the perf trace if helpful.

Simon: Please attach. Also @eng-runtime — can you prioritise review for PR 498? This is the main blocker for batching. :pray:

Eva: Small note on the cache migration: script will rewrite 2 keys per namespace, low impact. I'll post the migration plan after tests pass.

Ryan: Once Aj posts the runbook link, I'll drop in the console alert config (thresholds + notification targets). What's the Slack alert channel? #incidents or #support?

Aj: Put notifications to #incidents for now, will add pager duty if we see real regressions. Runbook link: https://repo.internal/optimize-toolkit/playbooks/regression-alerts.md

Maya: Code review pings: Aj -> please ping @Simon for PR612; Simon -> please ping @Eva for the cache migration PR once tests are green. Keep PRs small.

Simon: Ping received. I'll review PR612 after lunch :eyes:

Eva: Ack :thumbsup: will post test results in this thread.

Maya: Summary action items: 1) Aj: finalize perf runs + upload traces + add runbook (today). 2) Simon: review quant PR + coordinate with eng-runtime on PR498. 3) Eva: finish cache fix + migration plan (EOD). 4) Ryan: wire console alerts once runbook is up. 5) eng-runtime: prioritize runtime fix review.

Aj: I'll also add the canary config to the rollout PR and mark it for auto-fallback to model-small.

deploy-bot: ci/rollback-check 1766003000: ok :white_check_mark:

Maya: Thanks everyone — ping here if anything slips. Short async updates preferred. :shipit:
